The '''Hand Pot''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. As with other casinos in the [[Westrex]] District of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]], it was located on the [[Casino Line]]; although, it was comparatively smaller in size.
